extension.description: YouTube for Kodi without the bloat: search, browse and play with no API key and no sign-in, on Windows, Linux, CoreELEC, Android and every other Kodi platform. Subscriptions, Continue watching, history, Watch later and saved playlists are kept on this device; import your subscriptions from Google Takeout. Trending, Live now, Recommended and the Music, Gaming, News and Sports pages work as folders, widgets and skin hubs. SponsorBlock skips sponsored segments during playback and DeArrow replaces clickbait titles and thumbnails. Unofficial add-on; Google account sync is not available.
extension.news:
v0.5.1 - When a video cannot play as DASH, SmartTube now plays YouTube's HLS stream instead of the low-quality single file.
v0.5.0 - New setting General > HDR video. On plays the HDR version of a video on a Kodi 21 build that shows HDR video from add-ons, such as p3i firmware from 2026-10-30. Auto keeps HDR for Kodi 22 and later. Off never chooses the HDR version.
v0.4.0 - Play videos up to 4K60 in VP9, and in HDR on Kodi 22 or later when the display supports HDR. SmartTube now builds a DASH manifest from YouTube's separate audio and video files. - Seeks and SponsorBlock skips no longer freeze the picture: audio now starts at the same point as video. - Dubbed videos offer each audio language, with the original as the default.
v0.3.1 - SponsorBlock no longer skips far ahead after a seek: skips and resume points use only positions that continue playback. Kodi can report a wrong position while a seek runs.
v0.3.0 - Add app sections: Subscriptions, Continue watching, Recommended, Trending, History, Watch later, Channels, Playlists, Search history, and the Music, Gaming, News, Sports, Live, Learning and Fashion pages. - Every section has a fixed plugin path for skin hubs and widgets. - Follow up to 200 channels and import subscriptions.csv from Google Takeout. Followed channel IDs from the old setting move to the new list. - Context menus: go to channel, related videos, Watch later, save playlist, follow, and remove from history. - Resume points and watch history for videos played from SmartTube lists. Trailers and links from other add-ons stay out of the history. - DeArrow titles and thumbnails now apply: lookups go to the DeArrow API instead of the DeArrow website. - Faster Live now and DeArrow on long lists. The empty signed-out Home feed is removed.
v0.2.1 - SponsorBlock skips apply only to SmartTube videos; Plex episodes no longer inherit the last trailer's segments. - A skipped segment no longer loops when the stream resumes short of the segment end, and an outro at the end of a video finishes the video.
v0.2.0 - Add ranked trailer playback and trailer rows for Starlight and PlexKodiConnect. - Add Live now for followed and supplied subscription channels, with live source properties. - Exclude scheduled streams from Live now and correct nested route URLs.
v0.1.1 - Use a familiar red play-button icon instead of the placeholder artwork.
v0.1.0 - First release: no-API-key search, home feed, channel and playlist browsing and playback. - SponsorBlock segment skipping and DeArrow titles/thumbnails. - Accepts the old YouTube add-on search/play URL shapes, so skin links repoint by add-on id.
